name: vent_crawl
title: Raised vent with a ledge
summary: A crouch vent carved into a wall at sill height, with a ledge grab (LG GE) on its lip so spies can pull themselves in. The vent height follows the map's crouch numbers. Pivot: the floor at the wall face; the vent runs into the wall along -X.
